text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While passing through the busy area in<n>front of
the station...

text_block_list.name: Young Girl
text_block_list.text: Sob... Mommy... Where are you?

text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно
text_block_list.text:
What's the matter? Did you get<n>separated from
your mom?

text_block_list.name: Young Girl
text_block_list.text: Yeah...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Worry not! We'll find her for you at<n>once!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Hey, is anyone this girl's mommy?!<n>Anyoooone?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite the determined calls, no one<n>steps out
from the bustling crowd to<n>answer their pleas...

text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Oh, I've got it! ♪ Sorry, I'm just<n>going to
lift you up for a bit!

text_block_list.name: Young Girl
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно
text_block_list.text:
Up you go! So, can you see your mom<n>from up
there?

text_block_list.name: Young Girl
text_block_list.text: ...Oh! I can! She's near the karaoke sign!

text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно
text_block_list.text:
The lady in the white outfit! Oh no, she's<n>heading
away from us!

text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно
text_block_list.text:
Phew... We found your mom, but moving<n>through
this crowd is going to be<n>tough...

text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно
text_block_list.text: Which means you're up, Biko!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me! I'll fetch your mom right<n>over!
Bono, you provide backup via your<n>comms
device!

text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно
text_block_list.text: Call you with updates, right? ♪ Gotcha!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus makes deft use of her small<n>frame to
weave swiftly through the large<n>crowd.

text_block_list.name: Young Girl
text_block_list.text: She's so fast!

text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно
text_block_list.text:
Hello? Biko? The girl's mom is currently<n>moving
toward the beef bowl restaurant!

text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно
text_block_list.text:
Keep going straight! That's her! The lady<n>with the
long black hair and white<n>clothes!

text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно
text_block_list.text: Hooray! Biko finally caught up with your<n>mom!

text_block_list.name: Young Girl
text_block_list.text: Yay! Mommy!

text_block_list.name: Young Girl's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much! I don't know what I<n>would've
done without your help.

text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно
text_block_list.text: It was nothing! You're very welcome.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Isn't it great that we found your mom?

text_block_list.name: Young Girl
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Thank you both! Bye-bye!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The girl and her mom smile and wave as<n>they
leave.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Hm? You saw us teaming up?

text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно
text_block_list.text: It's all thanks to Biko chasing after the<n>girl's mom.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
But I couldn't have found her without<n>your help
tracking her, Bono!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Really?!

text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно
text_block_list.text:
For sure! It was so cool how you weaved<n>your way
through that crowd!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
You too, Bono! You were like a hero<n>giving me
orders from our tactical base!

text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно
text_block_list.text: Hehe, we make a pretty good duo!
